title: Smooth Marry Me Chicken
description: Sliced sous vide chicken breasts and farfalle in an extra-saucy, blended sun-dried tomato, cream and parmesan sauce.

ingredients.name: oil from the sun-dried tomato jar
fresh garlic
ingredients.note: minced, or 2 1/2 tsp jarred minced garlic

steps.title: Boil water
steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it with {pastasalt}.

steps.title: Cook pasta
steps.text: Cook {pasta} until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of the pasta water, then drain and set aside.

steps.title: Blend tomatoes
steps.text: In a measuring cup, blend {tomatoes} and {blendbroth} with an immersion blender until mostly smooth. Small bits are fine.

steps.title: Melt fats
steps.text: In a large skillet over medium heat, melt {butter} with {tomatooil}.

steps.title: Tomato base
steps.text: Add the blended tomato mixture, {italian} and {paprika}. Cook for 1 minute, stirring frequently.

steps.title: Broth
steps.text: Add {broth} and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Add {cream} and bring to a gentle simmer.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Simmer gently for 3 to 5 minutes until slightly thickened.

steps.title: Add chicken
steps.text: Add {chicken} and stir gently. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes until warmed through. Do not overcook, since the chicken is already fully cooked.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Add the cooked pasta to the sauce and toss until coated. Loosen with a little of the reserved pasta water if needed.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve the pasta with roasted broccoli on the side, plus extra grated parmesan and cracked black pepper if you like.

notes: Extra saucy version for 3 sous vide chicken breasts. For a little heat add 1/4 to 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes. A spoonful of Better Than Bouillon chicken base deepens the sauce. Rotini or penne work equally well. Leftovers reheat very well the next day with a splash of milk or cream. Pairs with APO Roasted Broccoli.
